title: Orbit tensor bundle and norm section for a finite family of automorphisms
statement: Let $Y$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $G$ a finite set, $\rho:G\to\operatorname{Aut}(Y)$ a family of scheme automorphisms, and $L$ a sheaf of $\mathcal O_Y$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. No group law, faithfulness, invertibility or ampleness is required. Fix the finite enumeration $e_G$ obtained from an equivalence $G\simeq\operatorname{Fin}(\#G)$, used only to order and parenthesize tensor products. Using module pullback [def-pc-module-pullback] and the sheaf tensor product and unit [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], define for a list $\ell$ in $G$ the translated tensor by $T_\rho(L,[]) = \mathcal O_Y$ and $T_\rho(L,g::\ell)=\rho(g)^*L\otimes T_\rho(L,\ell)$, and put $B_\rho(L)=T_\rho(L,e_G)$. Use $M^{\otimes0}=\mathcal O_Y$ and $M^{\otimes(d+1)}=M\otimes M^{\otimes d}$. For $d\in\mathbb N$, define $c_{\rho,L,d,\ell}:T_\rho(L^{\otimes d},\ell)\simeq T_\rho(L,\ell)^{\otimes d}$ recursively: for the empty list it is the inverse of the repeated-unitor isomorphism $\mathcal O_Y^{\otimes d}\simeq\mathcal O_Y$; for $g::\ell$ first apply the canonical pullback-power comparison [def-sc-tensor-pullback-power-comparison] in the first factor and $c_{\rho,L,d,\ell}$ in the second, then the inverse of the symmetric tensor-power distribution isomorphism $(A\otimes D)^{\otimes d}\simeq A^{\otimes d}\otimes D^{\otimes d}$. For a global section $s\in\Gamma(Y,M)$, define $t_\rho(s,[]) = 1$ and $t_\rho(s,g::\ell)=\rho(g)^*s\otimes t_\rho(s,\ell)$, where pullback of sections uses the normalized adjunction unit $s\mapsto1\otimes s$ of [def-pc-module-pullback]. Finally for $s\in\Gamma(Y,L^{\otimes d})$ define $\mathcal N_\rho(s)=\Gamma(c_{\rho,L,d,e_G})(t_\rho(s,e_G))\in\Gamma(Y,B_\rho(L)^{\otimes d})$. In particular this defines the orbit bundle and norm when $G$ is a finite group acting on $Y$.
